parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value from the previous API call.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify up to 50 resource IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid values:

- service: a service.

- serviceinstance: a service instance.

- artifact: an artifact.
